description: Create a youth soccer carpool coordination spreadsheet for the Lightning Bolts team. The spreadsheet must include: (1) Schedule of at least 8 practices/games in April with dates and times, (2) Driver assignments for each event, (3) Which kids each driver is picking up, (4) Emergency contact numbers for drivers, (5) A formula to count how many times each parent is driving (to ensure fairness). Organize the data in clear columns and save the file (Ctrl+S).
